records.source: Ah, yes. I have predicted your arrival a long time ago, young @.#$e#However, your fate is ultimately in your own hands.
records.translation: Ah, oo. Matagal ko nang nahulaan ang pagdating mo, batang @.#$e#Gayunman, nasa sarili mong mga kamay ang iyong kapalaran.

records.source: Ah, what do we have here? A rare and potent elixir, it seems. Yes, this will make a fine addition to my reagent chest.
records.translation: Ah, ano itong narito? Tila isang bihira at makapangyarihang eliksir. Oo, magiging mahusay na dagdag ito sa baul ng mga sangkap ko.

records.source: Ah... an arctic shard.#$b#A most powerful substance, indeed, and potently infused with the element of ice.#$b#I'll take it, if you don't mind.#$b#...#$b#...Erm...You're still here. Oh. You want something?#$b#...Take this.
records.translation: Ah... isang Tipak ng Arktiko.#$b#Tunay na napakamakapangyarihang sangkap, at puspos ng elemento ng yelo.#$b#Kukunin ko ito kung ayos lang sa iyo.#$b#...#$b#...Ah... Narito ka pa. O. May gusto ka ba?#$b#...Kunin mo ito.

records.source: Hmm... I suppose I could accompany you... yes. Once you've arrived, I shall appear. Farewell.
records.translation: Hmm... Marahil maaari kitang samahan... oo. Kapag dumating ka na, lilitaw ako. Paalam.

records.source: Though the unusual rains may be alarming, there is nothing to fear on this day.#$e#In fact, it is a day of great joy for many living things.
records.translation: Bagaman maaaring nakababahala ang di-pangkaraniwang ulan, walang dapat katakutan sa araw na ito.#$e#Sa katunayan, araw ito ng malaking kagalakan para sa maraming nilalang.

records.source: Nature is a powerful force, not to be trifled with.#$e#Excuse me, but there are special matters I can only attend to on this day.
records.translation: Makapangyarihang puwersa ang kalikasan at hindi dapat paglaruan.#$e#Paumanhin, pero may mga natatanging bagay na sa araw na ito ko lamang maaasikaso.

records.source: Marriage... hmm? I pray that you have better luck than I did...
records.translation: Pag-aasawa... hmm? Dalangin kong mas suwertehin ka kaysa sa akin...

records.source: It will be a challenge, to live with one such as Krobus. But richly rewarding to both parties, I'm sure.#$e#I admit, I am most interested to see the outcome of such an unusual friendship.
records.translation: Magiging hamon ang mamuhay kasama ang isang tulad ni Krobus. Ngunit tiyak kong lubos na magiging makabuluhan iyon para sa magkabilang panig.#$e#Aaminin kong lubos akong interesadong makita ang kalalabasan ng gayong di-pangkaraniwang pagkakaibigan.

records.source: Ah, yes. I have seen many things about your future, young @.#$e#If I were to tell you, there could be grave consequences.
records.translation: Ah, oo. Marami na akong nakita tungkol sa hinaharap mo, batang @.#$e#Kung sasabihin ko sa iyo, maaaring magkaroon ng malulubhang bunga.

records.source: Outside the domain of human civilization is where nature truly reveals its secrets.
records.translation: Sa labas ng saklaw ng kabihasnan ng tao tunay na ibinubunyag ng kalikasan ang mga lihim nito.

records.source: There are areas of the world, yet unsullied by the constraints of modern thinking, where magic is still very much alive...
records.translation: May mga lugar pa sa mundo na hindi nadudungisan ng mga limitasyon ng makabagong pag-iisip, kung saan buhay na buhay pa rin ang mahika...

records.source: While the scientific practice may accurately describe the material of our world, it will never explain the deepest mysteries...
records.translation: Bagaman tumpak na mailalarawan ng agham ang materya ng ating mundo, hindi nito kailanman maipaliliwanag ang pinakamalalalim na hiwaga...

records.source: If you have nothing important to tell me, leave me be. I have much work to do.
records.translation: Kung wala kang mahalagang sasabihin sa akin, hayaan mo ako. Marami akong kailangang gawin.

records.source: I trust you enough to allow you in my basement. Treat what you find there with respect.
records.translation: Sapat ang tiwala ko sa iyo upang papasukin ka sa silong ko. Igalang mo ang anumang makita mo roon.

records.source: Greetings, @. I trust you haven't been dabbling in the dark arts?
records.translation: Pagbati, @. Umaasa akong hindi mo sinusubukan ang madilim na mahika?

records.source: If reality is constructed by the mind, then if one were to master the power of mind, they could control reality...
records.translation: Kung binubuo ng isip ang realidad, maaaring kontrolin ng sinumang makapangingibabaw sa kapangyarihan ng isip ang realidad...

records.source: It takes years of study to understand the language of the elementals.#$e#To actually speak their language requires a lifetime of devoted effort.#$e#Now, if you'll excuse me...
records.translation: Ilang taon ng pag-aaral ang kailangan upang maunawaan ang wika ng mga Elemental.#$e#Habambuhay na masigasig na pagsisikap ang kailangan upang tunay na masalita ang kanilang wika.#$e#Ngayon, kung ipagpapaumanhin mo...

records.source: There are many mysteries around us. You must be patient if you wish to discover them.
records.translation: Maraming hiwaga sa paligid natin. Kailangan mong magtiyaga kung nais mong matuklasan ang mga iyon.

records.source: You musn't tell anyone... but I have reason to believe that one of the locals is actually my daughter...#$e#I could be mistaken... It's rare, but it does happen.
records.translation: Hindi mo dapat sabihin kaninuman... pero may dahilan akong maniwalang isa sa mga tagarito ang tunay kong anak na babae...#$e#Maaaring nagkakamali ako... Bihira iyon, pero nangyayari.

records.source: I believe the townsfolk are afraid of me.#$e#It is unfortunate, but I suppose it is human to be afraid of the unknown.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, natatakot sa akin ang mga tagabayan.#$e#Nakalulungkot, ngunit likas marahil sa tao ang matakot sa hindi nalalaman.

records.source: I was married, long ago. After my wife and I split, she began flying around the countryside, cursing everything she saw.#$e#It's not a very mature way to express one's anger.
records.translation: May asawa ako noong unang panahon. Nang maghiwalay kami, nagsimula siyang lumipad sa buong kabukiran at sumpain ang lahat ng makita niya.#$e#Hindi iyon paraang angkop sa isang may-gulang upang ipahayag ang galit.

records.source: Beware, you are standing above a potent magical field.#$e#I built my hut right here on purpose, you know.
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka, nakatayo ka sa ibabaw ng isang makapangyarihang mahiwagang larangan.#$e#Sinadya kong itayo mismo rito ang kubo ko, alam mo.

records.source: Have you made any headway with the forest spirits?
records.translation: May pagsulong ka na ba sa pakikipag-ugnayan sa mga espiritu ng gubat?

records.source: I sometimes observe the local villagers in secret.#$e#I am hoping to find an apprentice. Some day I will leave this mortal plane, but my arcane pursuits must continue.
records.translation: Minsan ay palihim kong minamasdan ang mga taganayon.#$e#Umaasa akong makahanap ng isang alagad. Balang araw, lilisanin ko ang mundong ito ng mga mortal, ngunit kailangang magpatuloy ang mga gawaing mahika ko.

records.source: Keep it up, kid. I think you're gonna be a star.#$e#Just ask me if you need anything.
records.translation: Ipagpatuloy mo lang, bata. Sa tingin ko, magiging bituin ka.#$e#Magtanong ka lang sa akin kung may kailangan ka.

records.source: I knew you'd end up here someday. Of course, I had to make it a little difficult so you'd have an incentive to achieve excellence.
records.translation: Alam kong makakarating ka rin dito balang araw. Siyempre, kinailangan kong pahirapan ito nang kaunti para may dahilan kang abutin ang kahusayan.

records.source: I was born an ordinary boy, but I made a decision early in life that I would become extraordinary.
records.translation: Ipinanganak akong karaniwang bata, pero maaga kong ipinasyang magiging pambihira ako.

records.source: Hey. Don't tell anyone about this place, okay? I want to keep it... exclusive.#$e#You'd keep a secret for your friend Mr. Qi, wouldn't you?
records.translation: Uy. Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman ang lugar na ito, ayos? Gusto kong panatilihin itong... eksklusibo.#$e#Maiingatan mo ang lihim para sa kaibigan mong si G. Qi, hindi ba?

records.source: Never stop striving to achieve perfection.#$e#Settle for nothing less than excellence in everything you do.
records.translation: Huwag kailanman tumigil sa pagsisikap na makamit ang Kasakdalan.#$e#Huwag tumanggap ng anumang kulang sa kahusayan sa lahat ng ginagawa mo.

records.source: Stop by whenever you wanna relax.
records.translation: Dumaan ka rito tuwing gusto mong magpahinga.

records.source: Keep working hard and maybe you'll end up like me someday.
records.translation: Patuloy kang magsikap at baka maging tulad ko rin balang araw.

records.source: That was a very auspicious wedding ceremony, @.#$b#...What? You didn't see me there?#$b#Hahaha... Kid... You can't keep a secret from Mr. Qi.
records.translation: Napakamapalad ng seremonya ng kasal na iyon, @.#$b#...Ano? Hindi mo ako nakita roon?#$b#Hahaha... Bata... Wala kang maitatagong lihim kay G. Qi.

records.source: There's more to this world than meets the eye, kid. Some day, you might understand.#$b#For now, just keep striving for excellence in everything you do.
records.translation: Higit pa sa nakikita ng mata ang mundong ito, bata. Balang araw, baka maunawaan mo.#$b#Sa ngayon, patuloy ka lang magsikap para sa kahusayan sa lahat ng ginagawa mo.

records.source: I got to where I am through the force of pure willpower, kid.#$b#You see... The mind is a very powerful tool.#$b#In fact, it's the most powerful tool in all of reality... and beyond.
records.translation: Narating ko ang kinalalagyan ko dahil sa dalisay na lakas ng kalooban, bata.#$b#Alam mo... Napakamakapangyarihang kasangkapan ang isip.#$b#Sa katunayan, ito ang pinakamakapangyarihang kasangkapan sa buong realidad... at sa ibayo pa.

records.source: I'm impressed with your tenacity, kid... it took a lot of walnuts to get this far.
records.translation: Hanga ako sa pagpupursigi mo, bata... napakaraming Ginintuang Walnut ang kinailangan upang makarating dito.

records.source: Wherever you go... I'm always behind the curtain, making sure the show is interesting. Hahaha...#$b#Or... am I?
records.translation: Saan ka man magpunta... Lagi akong nasa likod ng tabing at tinitiyak kong kawili-wili ang palabas. Hahaha...#$b#O... ganoon nga ba?

records.source: Set your eyes on the furthest star, and let that be your goal.#$b#It's always within your power to go one step further than you used to believe.
records.translation: Ituon mo ang mga mata sa pinakamalayong bituin at gawin mo iyong layunin.#$b#Palaging nasa kapangyarihan mong humakbang nang higit pa sa dati mong inaakala.

records.source: Some things transcend time and space, kid. It's a unique feeling in the heart... a whisper of things beyond.
records.translation: May mga bagay na lumalampas sa panahon at kalawakan, bata. Natatanging damdamin iyon sa puso... isang bulong mula sa ibayo.

records.source: On the left, you'll find a board with my special challenges... custom-tailored for you, kid.#$b#On the right, a set of fantastic prizes for those who meet my challenge...#$b#Good luck, kid.
records.translation: Sa kaliwa, makakakita ka ng pisarang may mga natatangi kong hamon... sadyang iniangkop para sa iyo, bata.#$b#Sa kanan, may mga kamangha-manghang premyo para sa mga tumutupad sa hamon ko...#$b#Suwertehin ka sana, bata.

records.source: ...Come back when you've got something to show me, kid.
records.translation: ...Bumalik ka kapag may maipapakita ka na sa akin, bata.
